confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Qingdao and comparable Chinese coastal cities. No live booking pages or listings were inspected, and no web search was used for city prices. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than July peak-season hotel and hostel rates, which could vary widely. The FX value was not verified on the RBA exchange-rates table: it comes from a partly garbled search snippet of the RBA homepage, which showed a 4.00 pm 15 Oct 2026 US dollar figure of about 0.6955. A third-party page citing the RBA gave 0.6947 for 16 Oct 2026. Verify against the RBA table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Chinese coastal tourist cities such as Dalian, Xiamen and Yantai, with a July summer-season uplift for accommodation. Beer anchors reflect typical restaurant pricing for domestic draft or bottled lager. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local price relationship to beer, roughly five to six times the beer price, because direct knowledge of bar prices is weaker.
